points.description: Defines a queue as a data structure that stores elements (accept equivalent wording such as 'a structure that holds data items'; accept 'queue' or 'வரிசை').
points.partial_credit: Half mark if the answer only calls it a data structure without saying it stores elements.

levels.says: Calls queue a data structure but does not say it stores elements.

points.description: States that a queue follows the First In First Out (FIFO) principle (accept 'FIFO', 'first in first out', or Tamil equivalent 'முதலில் வந்தது முதலில் வெளியேறும்'). Do not award if the answer states LIFO/last in first out.
Names enqueue (or the equivalent insertion operation, e.g., 'insertion'/'உள்ளிடுதல்') as a main operation of a queue. Do not accept stack operations such as push.
Names dequeue (or the equivalent deletion/removal operation, e.g., 'deletion'/'வெளியேற்றுதல்') as a main operation of a queue. Do not accept stack operations such as pop.

rubric.notes: Full marks require all four points: queue as a data structure storing elements, the FIFO principle, enqueue, and dequeue. Part marks are given for a partial definition in P1 or for naming only one of the two main operations. A LIFO/stack answer or push/pop operations does not earn the FIFO or operation points.
